meta_description: Study plan: viewer, weekly hour budget and export to Google Calendar and Outlook
file_missing_fields: meta, calendars or events fields are missing
file_invalid: The file does not look like a plan: {reason}
no_events: No events. Turn on at least one calendar.
no_events_this_week: No events this week. Turn on calendars above or go to another week.
budget_note: The Saturday buffer and the gym do not count toward the budget. Time zone {timezone}, plan updated {date}.
export_hint: One .ics file per calendar. Works with any calendar that imports .ics.
howto_google: Google Calendar: Settings → Import & export → select the .ics → choose the calendar with the same name.
howto_outlook: Outlook: Add calendar → Upload from file → select the .ics and the calendar.
howto_duplicates: Before importing again, delete the old events from these calendars, otherwise you will get duplicates.
recurring_hint: The change applies to every repeat.
error_time_order: The end must be after the start.
export_mark_done: Mark finished sessions with ✓ and free their time
howto_unzip: Unzip the archive: each calendar is its own .ics file.
howto_create_first: First create the calendars marked “create calendar”: the import does not create them.
howto_apple: Apple Calendar: open the .ics file (on a Mac: File → Import) and choose the calendar to add the events to.
howto_other: Any calendar that reads iCalendar (.ics) files: look for Import in its settings.
export_hint_single: All selected events in one .ics file, to import them into a single calendar.
howto_single: The file holds every selected event: import it into the one calendar you want.
full_day_hint: Show every hour of the day, not only the hours with events
expand_hint: Calendar across the whole window: no header, runway or budget
field_free_time: Free time: does not count toward the weekly budget
new_event_hint: New event. In the week grid, double-click an empty slot
calendars_hint: Rename, recolor, add, clear or remove a calendar. What you remove goes to the trash.
delete_calendar: Move the calendar “{name}” and its events to the trash
calendar_chip_hint: Click to hide or show. Double-click to show only this calendar
file_same: The file matches the project plan.
file_changes: Events changed: {count}. Changes stay in the browser until you download the file.
file_edit_hint: You can edit it like the plan itself: changes do not touch the project.
nothing_planned: Nothing is planned for the next three weeks.
progress_hint: Mark sessions done in the event card and the rings fill up.
plan_map_hint: A bar is the study hours of a week, red when above the {budget} budget. A cell is a day in the color of its main course; pale means everything is done.
trash_hint: Removed items stay here for {days} days and can be restored; after that they are removed for good.
calendar_cleared: Events of “{name}” moved to the trash
clear_calendar_hint: Move every event of the calendar to the trash and keep the calendar
delete_event_hint: The event goes to the trash
shortcut_resize_event: Change the length of the focused event
shortcut_delete_event: Remove the focused event (a repeat is skipped)
reader_back: Back to the plan on screen
reader_drop_hint: You can drop a plan.json file here.
reader_is_project: This is the project plan, so there is nothing to compare. Choose a file to see how it differs.
history_hint: Every change in order. Pick a point to move the plan there, back or forward.
dash_ahead: ahead of the plan ({hours} due by now)
dash_behind: behind the plan ({hours} due by now)
dash_burnup_hint: The plan climbs to the total; the green line is what is done so far.
dash_weekly_hint: Planned hours by calendar; the line is the budget of {hours} a week.
shift_hint: Moves every session that is not done, starting from the chosen date. Done sessions stay where they are; the shift can be undone from the history.
spent_hint: Your pace and the finish forecast are worked out from this time.
dash_forecast_hint: How long a planned hour really takes, judging by the time you logged, and when the rest will be finished at that pace.
dash_forecast_none: Log the time you spent in a session's card and the forecast will appear here.
dash_forecast_miss: the forecast is {count} d past it
catchup_hint: Sessions missed: {count}. Compare the options: each is applied as one step and can be undone from the history.
catchup_nothing: Nothing is missed and your pace matches the plan: there is nothing to change.
catchup_keep: Leave the plan as it is
catchup_push_hint: Every open session slides to the next study days. The weekly load stays, the plan ends later.
catchup_squeeze: Make it up in the coming weeks
catchup_squeeze_hint: Only the missed sessions move: into the Saturday buffers and one more hour after a day's sessions. The end stays, the weeks get heavier.
catchup_unplaced: No room was found for {count} sessions
catchup_pace: Give the sessions the time they really take
catchup_pace_hint: Every session ahead gets the length its course's pace asks for. The days stay; a day's sessions follow one another.
catchup_hint_pace: Nothing is missed, but your pace differs from the plan. The option is applied as one step and can be undone from the history.
